  rsq r33.x, r33.x
  mul r35.xyz, r0.xyzx, r33.xxxx
  mad r34.xyz, r34.xyzx, l(0.700000, 0.700000, 0.700000, 0.000000), r35.xyzx
  dp3 r33.x, r34.xyzx, r34.xyzx
  rsq r33.x, r33.x
  mul r34.xyz, r34.xyzx, r33.xxxx
  dp3 r33.x, v3.xyzx, v3.xyzx
  rsq r33.x, r33.x
  mul r37.xyz, v3.xyzx, -r33.xxxx
  add r37.xyz, r37.xyzx, -cb1[4].xyzx
  dp3 r33.x, r37.xyzx, r37.xyzx
  rsq r33.x, r33.x
  mul r37.xyz, r37.xyzx, r33.xxxx
  dp3 r33.x, r34.xyzx, r37.xyzx

  mad r33.y, r33.y, l(-0.004050000), l(1.000000)

  mul r33.x, r33.x, r37.w
  mov r33.y, r36.y
  mul r33.x, r33.x, r33.y
  add r32.y, r32.y, r33.x
  add r34.xyz, r37.xyzx, -r35.xyzx
  mad r34.xyz, r34.xyzx, r33.xxxx, r35.xyzx
  dp3 r33.y, r34.xyzx, r34.xyzx
  rsq r33.y, r33.y
  mul r0.xyz, r34.xyzx, r33.yyyy
  add r33.y, -r30.x, l(0.250000)
  mad r30.x, r33.x, r33.y, r30.x
endif
mov r29.x, r30.z
max o0.x, r30.x, l(0.001000)
mad_sat r33.x, r32.y, l(1.000000), l(0.000000)
add r33.y, l(0.020000), -r3.x
mad r3.xy, r33.xxxx, r33.yyyy, r3.xyxx

eq r34.x, r33.y, l(8.000000)
movc r1.xyz, r34.xxxx, r32.wwww, r1.xyzx
dp3 r2.y, r0.xyzx, cb1[277].xyzx
mov o0.xyzw, r0.xyzw
mov o2.xyzw, r3.xywz
mov o1.xyzw, r1.xyzw
// EDCAS terrain mask: this ground's distance from the camera (m), for the dust
dp3 r38.x, v3.xyzx, v3.xyzx
sqrt o4.x, r38.x
ret
